content_blocks.label: clause_1._Termination_of_Tenancy
content_blocks.text: This notice serves to terminate the tenancy of the Tenant as of October 5, 2024...

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Reason_for_Termination
content_blocks.text: The Tenant has failed to pay rent in full on or before the due date, which constitutes a material breach of the lease agreement...

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Removal_of_Personal_Property
